articles.title: Coda Octopus Group Reports $1.3m Engineering Services Order

articles.summary: Murray, Utah - Coda Octopus Colmek, Inc. is pleased to announce its transition to Coda Octopus Engineering, Inc., effective immediately. This strategic name change better aligns the company's identity with its core capabilities and strengthens its position within the Coda Octopus Group (NASDAQ: CODA) family of companies.
